thread:
olivia park: Quick thought: we should surface a /policies/{id}/simulate endpoint in the console that runs a single request through the exact evaluation path and returns the decision + human-friendly explanation. would help product and SRE validate.

daniel wu: love this. important to include the full predicate evaluation log (which triggers fired, predicate values) but redact user PII.

harry choi: how do we handle sampling? simulate should be able to force a sampling seed so results are deterministic for tests. maybe allow ?seed=1234.

leah rivers: also allow hooking a small synthetic KV/cache state so people can see cache-hit vs miss behavior in the example decision.

kevin chen: API design: POST /policies/{id}/simulate { "input": {...}, "seed": 123, "dry_run": true, "env_overrides": {"qps": 500} } -> returns action, evaluation_trace_id, explanation. Rate-limit at 20r/min per org.

olivia park: UX: embed this simulate panel beneath the policy editor with a toggle to 'record' which will log the simulated decision into the audit table (flagged as simulated). default unchecked.

daniel wu: audit schema: store policy_id, policy_version, simulated(boolean), seed, matched_triggers[], action_taken, reason_text, trace_id, request_metadata (redacted). Keep each field searchable.

harry choi: telemetry: emit metric fallback_simulated_count and simulated_decisions_by_trigger. separate from real fallback metrics.

leah rivers: governance: simulated logs should respect tenant retention policies and GDPR deletion. admins can purge simulated rows with a single API call.

ops-bot: rollout plan: policy-sim feature -> canary 2% -> 10% -> 100%

kevin chen: console note: when enabling record, show a warning modal "Simulated decisions may include redacted request context. Do not use recorded traces for production billing." Also show a badge in the audit table row "simulated" and a filter to hide simulated rows.

olivia park: sample YAML for an inline policy to ship in the editor (different than earlier):
```yaml
schema_v: 2
id: web-guest-fallback
description: Fallbacks for guest-facing web endpoints
conditions:
  - name: spike_qps
    type: metric_threshold
    metric: qps
    comparator: ">="
    value: 1000
  - name: error_rate
    type: ratio_threshold
    numerator: errors_5xx
    denominator: requests
    threshold: 0.03
actions:
  - name: cheap_route
    type: route_model
    model: cheap-1b-quant
    sample: 0.5
  - name: soft_reject
    type: reject_with_message
    code: 503
    message_key: maintenance_short
cooldowns:
  default_window_s: 120
  per_tenant_jitter_pct: 15
audit:
  retain_days: 90
  include_eval_stack: true
```

kevin chen: one more API: /policies/{id}/replay?from=ts1&to=ts2 that re-evaluates a range of recorded requests against a new policy version in dry-run mode and returns a summary (delta in fallback_rate, expected errors). Useful for rollouts.

leah rivers: replay is great but must be scoped: only org-admins or RBAC role with "policy:replay" and must not emit notifications to customers. replay should operate on anonymized request blobs.

ops-bot: policy-sim staged deploy: canary 2% started

harry choi: UX micro-idea: in the replay summary show a small histogram of "would have fallen back vs would have stayed" and list top 5 tenants affected.

olivia park: rollout safety: by default, if replay indicates a delta in fallback_rate > 5% across top 10 tenants, block automated deployment and require manual approval. allow override with reason logged.

kevin chen: implementation note: evaluation must be deterministic across versions for given seed + stable predicate semantics. we need a compatibility test harness in CI.

daniel wu: also document that changes to predicate language semantics are breaking and must bump schema_v. Put lint checks in PRs.

leah rivers: testing: QA wants a tiny demo harness app that emits synthetic traces and allows toggling condition metrics in UI. can be a simple node service.

ops-bot: canary metrics: simulated_decisions=0.45s, replay_job_queue=0.1s

harry choi: final ask: add a small "explainability" modal that expands each audit row and shows bullet points: matched condition, values, sample-roll (0.34 < 0.5 => taken), selected action. short, non-technical explanation for product folks.

olivia park: great. i'll draft a spec with endpoints, RBAC scopes, retention defaults, and a mockup of the simulate panel. tagging @daniel, @leah, @kevin for review.

kevin chen: can wire up simulate endpoint in staging after ops-bot finishes canary.

ops-bot: canary 2% healthy -> promoting to 10%

olivia park: thanks team. i'll post the spec in #eng-platform in ~30m.

leah rivers: thanks all :raised_hands:
